short_description: Planck function as surface flux, pi*B_lambda, Teff 10-200,000 K (SVO bbody times pi)
description: Blackbody surface fluxes F_lambda = pi*B_lambda(T) for 588 temperatures from 10 to 200,000 K, 1 Angstrom to 10^7 Angstrom, from SVO's "Black Body" grid. SVO's files hold B_lambda (per steradian), which integrates to sigma*T^4/pi; NJM's files are SVO's times pi, so like every other grid they hold a surface flux that integrates to sigma*T^4.

credit: The Planck function (Planck 1901, Annalen der Physik 309, 553), as tabulated by the SVO Theory Server, times pi
flux_quantity: surface flux F_lambda = pi*B_lambda(T), in erg/s/cm2/A
notes: Multiplied by pi on 30 Oct 2026 (Nill's decision), with SED_Tools' own reader and writer; the previous copy, SVO's B_lambda files as downloaded, is in grid_holding/bbody-B_lambda-20261030. The bibcode of Planck (1901) is given from knowledge, not checked here.

bbb.is: a July 2026 re-cleaning of these 588 SVO bbody files (files named bbody_fid*.txt)
bbb.identical: 579 of 588 spectra have the same data lines as bbody's; the other 9 (bbody_fid417-fid425, 29,000-37,000 K) are bbody's flux times a constant 0.31-0.17 each, from the April 2026 renormalisation, so bbb is not a pure copy; its headers were rewritten with logg = nan and metallicity = nan
bbb.cube: empty: the NaN axes placed no spectrum
